Five members of the E2F family have been previously reported, namely E2F1-5. All five are key elements in transcriptional regulation of essential genes, and they can be divided into two functional groups, those that induce S-phase progression when overexpressed in quiescent cells (E2Fs 1–3), and those that do not (E2Fs 4–5). Here, we describe the identification of a novel member of this family, which we refer to as E2F-6.
